metaDescription: Affordable, reliable printing for the Shinawatra University community. Black-and-white and color printing, with convenient campus delivery.
heroBody: Need to print class notes or an assignment before the deadline? We're happy to help with quality printing, friendly service, and prices that are easy to understand.
campusNote: We currently accept orders within the Shinawatra University main campus area only.
qualityText: Get sharp black-and-white prints and vibrant color, with your documents reproduced clearly and carefully.
valueText: Know how much your order will cost before you send us your files.
deliveryText: Have your order delivered to your accommodation or another convenient location on campus.
servicesBody: Whether you need a single page in a hurry or a full set of class notes, we're here to make ordering your prints simple and convenient.
pricingBody: Prices are per A4 sheet. Single-sided and double-sided printing cost the same.
samePrice: Single-sided and double-sided printing cost the same
contactBody: Send us your files, let us know how many copies you need, and tell us how you'd like to receive your order. We'll help you arrange the details.
